feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
The importance of maintaining high standards for the BIP (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal) editorial team is emphasized, with a preference expressed for refreshing the team rather than lowering entry requirements. The BIP process is recognized as a vital yet under-resourced aspect of the Bitcoin ecosystem, necessitating greater commitment and support from dedicated contributors.
Efforts are underway to allocate more time and resources to the BIP process, particularly through organizational adjustments at Vinteum. Regular activities at Vinteum include reviewing and discussing BIPs and technical specifications, with recent focus areas such as output descriptors, Miniscript—explored in depth in [this article](https://www.vinteum.org/blog/inside-a-vinteum-deep-dive-the-standards-behind-bitcoin-wallets)—and Stratum V2, detailed further in [this blog post](https://www.vinteum.org/blog/inside-a-vinteum-deep-dive-bitcoin-mining-from-protocol-to-silicon).
Relevant professional experience includes academic peer review duties and a leadership role in research at Vinteum. The same rigorous attention to detail brought to academic work has been applied to recent BIP reviews, highlighting a commitment to quality and thoroughness in the proposal evaluation process.
A nomination is put forward for Daniela Brozzoni as a potential BIP editor, acknowledging her consistent and significant contributions to improving BIP specification clarity, her readiness to undertake editorial responsibilities, and her effective management of repository maintenance tasks. Her skills and dedication are presented as strong qualifications for the editorial position.
